summary: Writes the game configuration file. Resolves the target path (explicit lpFileName, else the stored default at this+0x0, else the global empty path byte_5EA438), clears the read-only attribute via ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API with flag 128, opens the file in write-text mode through sub_587DB0(aWt), and if the open fails returns 0. On success streams formatted sections via StringFormatWithNestedIO: directory paths (components, season, sound, vehiclesound, options*, replay, movie, tracks, vehicles, drivers, log, save, music, cameraeditor), hardware/video settings (gridsize, cpurating, systemram, videoram, objdetail, texdetail, videoguid, videodriver, videomode, videorefresh, windowedmode, runbenchmarks, fsaa, vsync, vbstrategy), install settings (install, installfrom, installto, autolaunch), mode (via FieldAccessorAt0x20/ArrayIndexedPointerGetter on dword_5EA43C, sub_404D20 + CRTFtol), launchtime, and version strings. Closes the file and returns 1.

local_names.v5: file handle used for all formatted writes
local_names.v7: pointer from FieldAccessorAt0x20(&dword_5EA43C) passed to ArrayIndexedPointerGetter
local_names.v8: mode value from sub_404D20(&dword_5EA43C) converted by CRTFtol

operations.description: Resolve target path: if lpFileName is null, fall back to the stored default *this, and if that is null use the global empty path byte_5EA438
Open config file in write-text mode: v4 = sub_587DB0(v2, aWt); if the handle is null return 0

Directory section: StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aComponents_0), then aSeasondirS, aSounddirS, aVehiclesoundS, aOptionsanimS, aOptionsflagsS, aOptionssoundsS, aOptionsdirS, aReplaydirS, aMoviedirS, aTracksdirS, aVehiclesdirS, aDriversdirS, aLogdirS, aSavedirS, aMusicdirS, aCameraeditorre_0
ShortComputation_3060(this) prepares a setting value before the next write group
Hardware section: StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aGridsizeD), aCpuratingD, aSystemramD, aVideoramD, aObjdetailD, aTexdetailD
ShortComputation_3060(v5) is invoked a second time before the video group, with the file handle passed instead
Video section: StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aVideoguidS), aVideodriverD, aVideomodeD, aVideorefreshD, aWindowedmodeD, aRunbenchmarksD, aFsaaD, aVsyncD, aVbstrategyD
Install section: StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aInstall_0), aInstallfromS, aInstalltoS, aAutolaunch_0
Mode value: v7 = FieldAccessorAt0x20(&dword_5EA43C) then ArrayIndexedPointerGetter(v7)
Mode line: v8 = sub_404D20(&dword_5EA43C), convert with CRTFtol(v8), then StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aModeS)
Version lines: StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aVersion_1) then StringFormatWithNestedIO(v5, aVersionF)
Invoked by ConfigIniParser (00421CD0), SessionReset (0042D350) and VidMan_Enter (004FA000) to persist settings
